Aisha (Support): Heads up - tenant 'pinecrest' onboarding hit a 403 during key creation. Customer has a live pilot demo tomorrow AM.
Liam (CSM): Renewal check in 10 days; mark as high-risk until resolved. Need comms plan + temporary fix.
Aisha (Support): Ticket #68912. Log excerpt:
```
2026-03-22T22:41:02Z ERROR provision 403 {"error":"missing_tenant_claim"}
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc' -d '{"tenant":"pinecrest"}'
```
Priya (CS Ops): Proposed comms: 1) Immediate ack to customer w/ ETA 3h (Aisha) 2) Infra to generate tenant-scoped temp token (Marco) 3) Daily status emails until resolved (Liam) 4) Ops to add provisioning smoke test to onboarding checklist (Priya).
Liam (CSM): Send ack now and offer to shift demo if needed. Also alert account exec.
Aisha (Support): Ack sent. Customer replied: "Please escalate, demo critical." :exclamation:
Marco (Infra): Investigating. Looks like the token issuer tightened validation; I can issue a short-lived tenant-scoped token (TTL 6h) as a stopgap. Will log audit entry.
Liam (CSM): Approve temporary token if it's tenant-scoped + TTL and we add rotation after onboarding.
AuditBot: Temp token request recorded (#temp-req-924). Audit trail created.
Marco (Infra): Generated token and delivered via secure channel. Confirmed customer can see keys in UI and completed test import.
Priya (CS Ops): Action items:
- Aisha: paste ticket + secure convo into CS handoff doc (owner Aisha)
- Marco: open infra ticket for permanent policy adjustment (owner Marco)
- Liam: notify account exec and add renewal note (owner Liam)
- Priya: update onboarding checklist with smoke test (owner Priya)
Aisha (Support): Handoff doc added: https://docs.redwood.ai/handoffs/68912 (logs + ack)
Marco (Infra): Filed INF-1151 to relax validation or update tooling; will include rollout plan.
Liam (CSM): I'll run the demo fallback plan with the customer and capture any enablement feedback.
Priya (CS Ops): Closing loop: keep ticket open until INF-1151 is done and runbook updated. Thanks team. :handshake:
